messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large four-legged creature with the head, thick brown fur, legs and clawed paws of a brown bear, combined with a glossy dark reddish-brown segmented beetle-like exoskeleton covering its back, shoulders, sides and legs, a curved forked beetle horn on its forehead, and a narrow tapering segmented armored tail at the rear, standing in side view facing right.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "brown bear", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark rhinoceros beetle horn", "part": "horn", "where": "on top of the head between the ears"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on the top sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "bear eyes", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "bear muzzle with black nose", "part": "muzzle", "where": "at the front of the head"}, {"looks_like": "thick furry bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with long claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom ends of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "narrow segmented armored insect tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark reddish-brown segmented beetle carapace", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back from behind the head to the rear"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark reddish-brown beetle armor plates", "part": "plates", "where": "on the shoulders, neck, sides and over the legs"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown bear fur", "part": "fur", "where": "on the head, neck, underside and limbs between the armor"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
